scope: Same-host process-crash recovery with a surviving private journal, not lost-runner or distributed lease recovery

focusedTests.command: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/recovery-cli.test.mjs tests/recovery.test.mjs tests/recovery-process.test.mjs tests/fixture-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/postgres-adapter-guards.test.mjs

localEvidence.fullTypecheckAndVerify: NOT_RUN: local peer dependencies unavailable; exact-source hosted CI required
localEvidence.coverage: New module included in unchanged 90/85/85 gates; local instrumentation passed thresholds but full local coverage command failed its CLI compatibility test because jiti is unavailable. Hosted coverage required.

requirements.requirement: Durable intent before acquisition, normal acknowledgments and interrupted acquisition
Dead-owner verification, active and same-label ownership protection, exact filters
Non-stealable live claims, resumable dead claimants and timeout safety
Private stamped files and optional owned authentication adapter integration
Public dry-run/apply CLI and isolated installed npm/pnpm adoption
Exact journal-bound PostgreSQL ownership and real SQL replay

remainingBoundaries: Ephemeral-runner loss and cross-host owner/claim liveness need an external durable ownership/liveness authority.
No remote account deletion for borrowed users; full consumer infrastructure lost-runner recovery is not claimed.
No hostile same-OS-user or network-filesystem race guarantees; no guarantee against power/storage loss.
Public publication, stable promotion, released Action tags and public docs deployment are not claimed.
